split_summary.prediction_landmark: end of first ICU day; hospital mortality outcome

rule_lactate.description: Elevated lactate supplies prototype evidence of metabolic stress.
rule_lactate.clinical_interpretation: The rule increases support for the lactate feature without diagnosing shock or determining mortality.
rule_lactate.source: Prototype lactate probe at 4 mmol/L, a historical severe-sepsis screen. Not a Surviving Sepsis treatment instruction.

rule_hypotension.condition: minimum day-1 systolic blood pressure <= 90 mmHg
rule_hypotension.description: Low systolic blood pressure supplies prototype evidence of hemodynamic instability.
rule_hypotension.clinical_interpretation: The rule increases support for the blood-pressure feature; it is not a stand-alone mortality decision.
rule_hypotension.source: Prototype hypotension screen at a systolic pressure of 90 mmHg. Not an expert-reviewed NGTA rule.

rule_age.description: Age of at least 75 years supplies prototype demographic evidence.
rule_age.clinical_interpretation: The rule increases support for the age feature without treating age as sufficient for mortality.
rule_age.source: Prototype age stratum at 75 years. Not a treatment threshold.

rule_creatinine.description: Elevated creatinine supplies prototype evidence of renal dysfunction.
rule_creatinine.clinical_interpretation: The rule increases support for the creatinine feature without diagnosing kidney injury or determining mortality.
rule_creatinine.source: Prototype creatinine flag at 2.0 mg/dL. This is not a KDIGO acute-kidney-injury definition.

interface_notes.neural_truth_mapping: variance-derived heuristic initializer for NARS-style confidence
interface_notes.symbolic_rule_grounding: explicit NAL deduction from direct observation before revision
interface_notes.revision_assumption: neural and symbolic truths are treated as distinct evidential sources
interface_notes.rule_firing: conditions are evaluated independently and any subset may fire
interface_notes.inference_pass: revision and gated-logit recomputation occur once with no convergence loop
interface_notes.conflict_policy: multiple rules targeting one logical feature are rejected pending explicit provenance-aware resolution
